item.title: SOG Outdoor Gear - 3 Piece Set with Nylon Sheaths
item.description:
Didn’t you say we were going camp? Look, look, I’ve got my Noel Coward books, a dress made from camouflage netting, a bootleg copy of Liberace sings Judy Garland, and a three piece SOG Outdoor Gear set! Here, let me take them out of their included nylon sheaths… oh, come on, no reaction? If that joke was in a John Waters movie you all would have died!

Okay, fine, well, here. This is an SOG Entrenching Tool. It looks just like a shovel, which is what Maddie used when she hit Adam for kissing Gwen. You know in As The World Turns? Don’t you guys keep up? Okay, well, you can also use it to dig latrines or graves or whatever it is you did last summer. And it folds up, so that’s nice too.

And here’s the SOG Hand Axe, in case anyone wants to play The Shining later. You know? Heeeeere’s Johnny! Oh, come ON, ladies, that was ‘79, you’ve had plenty of time to catch up. Okay, here, here’s an easy one. The SOG Camp Saw. We’ll use it to cut those bananas off the tree and make Carmen Miranda hats. You know, Carmen Miranda? Really? REALLY?

Well if you aren’t going to make the effort I don’t see how we’re possibly going to go camping together. What is that, two tents? Well, you should take a stress pill then! Huh? Huh? Oh, honestly, that one’s a classic. Get over yourselves.

 

Warranty: 1 Year SOG

Special Shipping Note: Adult signature required

SOG Entrenching Tool (F08)

  • Compact folding shovel and pick
  • All-steel construction entrenching tool uses a tempered steel blade with teeth cut into one side for cutting and slashing
  • Triangular handle is strong and fits the hand well
  • Folded, the entrenching tool takes up about the same space as a stack of paper plates -- 7.5" x 5" x 2.5" (L x W x H)
  • Includes nylon sheath

  • Length: 18.25” (46.4 cm)

  • Steel: High Carbon

  • Sheath: Nylon

SOG Hand Axe (F09)

  • Camp axe designed for chopping and cutting wood

SOG Folding Camp Saw (F10)
